mapper.select: select behavior_type, rebate_desc, rebate_type, rebate_config from daily_behavior_rebate where state = 'open' and behavior_type = #{behaviorType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_behavior_rebate(behavior_type, rebate_desc, rebate_type, rebate_config, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{behaviorType}, #{rebateDesc}, #{rebateType}, #{rebateConfig}, #{state}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_behavior_rebate SET state=#{state}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
